title: Cap. X: Imputed justice also covers all our other sins (Rom. 5:16)
pass_a_gloss: Besides, the imputation of justice is necessary not only that we may be justified from the reatus of inhering vice, but also from all our other sins. For that which God freely grants is justification from many falls. Romans 5:16.
pass_b_english: Moreover, the imputation of justice is needed not only to clear us of the guilt of the vice that inheres, but also to justify us from all our other sins. What God freely grants is justification from many falls (Rom. 5:16).
source_text: Caeterum necessaria est imputatio justitiae non modo ut a reatu vitii inhaerentis, verum etiam ut ab omnibus aliis nostris peccatis justificemur. Id enim quod Deus gratificatur est ex multis lapsibus ad justificationem. Rom.5.16.

choices.decision: imputed justice needed also for all other sins, not only inhering vice

notes: Cap. X Superest ultima densify section 128 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 127–130 tip).
